question: Who has been appointed as India’s first Woman Aide-De-Camp by the governor of Mizoram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manisha Padhi **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Padhi** has been appointed as India's first Woman Aide-De-Camp by the governor of Mizoram.
 
• An Aide-De-Camp (ADC) is a personal assistant or secretary to a person of high rank, usually a senior military officer or a head of state.
 
• This appointment is a significant milestone in the Indian armed forces, highlighting the increasing role of women in defense services.
 
• Manisha Padhi's appointment reflects the ongoing efforts to ensure gender equality and representation within the armed forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Historically, the role of ADC has been predominantly held by men, making Manisha Padhi's appointment a groundbreaking achievement.
 
• The role of an ADC involves a variety of duties including administrative tasks, ceremonial functions, and acting as a liaison between their superior and other officials.
 
• This appointment is part of a broader initiative to integrate more women into various roles within the Indian armed forces.
 
• The Indian government and military have been actively working towards creating a more inclusive environment and providing equal opportunities for women.
